content.title: How to watch the 2026 Masters: Full live TV schedule from Augusta National
content.text: Everything you need to know about how to watch the 2026 Masters as the first major of the season gets underway…JUMP TO: TV Schedule – US | TV Schedule – UKThe 90th Masters coverage from Augusta National is set to be the tournament’s most encompassing ever, broadcasting live to a global audience from more than 200 countries and territories. Wall-to-wall tournament coverage begins on Thursday, April 9, with the action also being streamed live via the Masters website and app, which features scoring, interactive player tracking, video highlights, in-depth tournament news coverage, and much more.The notorious Amen Corner stream will again be available, focusing on the famous three-hole stretch from the 11th. A feed of the 4th, 5th and 6th holes will go live each day as soon as the opening group reaches that part of the course, with another stream covering the 15th and 16th holes.What’s new in 2026?Remember when we used to complain about not being able to see any early-round coverage on the opening two days at Augusta? Well, that will be changing this year thanks to Amazon. On Thursday and Friday, Prime Video will make its golf broadcasting debut by streaming the action before the traditional broadcasters take over for the afternoon slots. A welcome addition to the 2025 coverage will also return. Users of Masters digital platforms will have access to live and recorded data on every single shot from each player during their range sessions, including distance, carry, speeds, and more. Each shot will deliver a 3D tracing, and a full scatterplot for every player will be available for each day of their range sessions.HDR live video will be available for all Masters live streams on the tournament website and the apps for those with compatible devices. This will provide richer, more lifelike colors, better showcasing the vibrant beauty of Augusta National in bloom.Here’s a complete rundown of how to watch, stream, and listen to the 90th Masters Tournament…How to watch the 2026 Masters in the USAmazon and ESPN will carry live coverage of tournament play on Thursday and Friday, before CBS takes over for the weekend. The broadcaster also no longer provides a highlights package from Augusta. You can, however, listen to live radio coverage on BBC Radio 5 Live and Sports Extra. Speaking of which…How to listen to the MastersSiriusXM radio will broadcast live throughout the week, beginning at 7am ET on Thursday and Friday, and 8am ET on Saturday and Sunday.
